annotations.title: Change the AI email reply settings

description: Change one website's AI email reply settings. Pass only the fields to change. Switching replies on needs reply_mode. With auto, the AI emails real customers by itself, so confirm with the user first. Needs the Pro plan or higher.

alert_email.description: Where those alerts go. Empty: the account email.

email_alerts_enabled.description: Email the team when an email needs a person.

enabled.description: Switch AI email replies on or off.

reply_delay_minutes.description: auto mode: minutes the AI waits before it sends (0 = at once).

reply_mode.description: auto: the AI sends its replies. draft: it writes drafts for a person to send.

sender_name.description: Name the customer sees as the sender.

support_email.description: The shop's own support address, for example support@yourshop.com.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

when_not_to_reply.description: Kinds of emails the AI must leave for a person.

when_to_reply.description: Kinds of emails the AI should answer. Empty: all it can.

name: update_email_settings
